scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,web,api,worker -c magenta,cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev:shared" "cd apps/web && node --preserve-symlinks --preserve-symlinks-main ../../node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev -p 3000" "npm run dev --workspace @certiflow/api" "npm run dev:worker --workspace @certiflow/api"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -n shared,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:shared" "cd apps/web && node --preserve-symlinks --preserve-symlinks-main ../../node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev -p 3000"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @certiflow/shared && npm run build --workspace @certiflow/api && cd apps/web && node --preserve-symlinks --preserve-symlinks-main ../../node_modules/next/dist/bin/next build
